name: std::iswdigit
intro:
Checks if the given wide character corresponds (if narrowed) to one of the ten decimal digit characters 0123456789.

If the value of ch is neither representable as a wchar_t nor equal to the value of the macro WEOF, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Non-zero value if the wide character is a numeric character, zero otherwise.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: std::iswdigit and std::iswxdigit are the only standard wide character classification functions that are not affected by the currently installed C locale.

examples.output:
In American locale:
           '3'   '\u4e09'  '３'
iswdigit: true  false false
jdigit:   false false false
 
In Japanese locale:
           '3'   '\u4e09'  '３'
iswdigit: true  false false
jdigit:   false false true
